role: Hard wall-clock timeout for strap SDK calls: runs the operation in its own Task and resumes the caller at the first of result, deadline, or caller cancellation; late results are dropped.
types: StrapRace<T>: class (private, Sendable) — lock-protected continuation + clock/call tasks + cancelled flag
ResumeOnce<T>: class (private, Sendable) — resumes a CheckedContinuation at most once

units.does: Awaits `operation` with a hard deadline of `seconds`: builds a StrapRace, parks the caller in a checked continuation, and on caller cancellation calls race.cancel(); throws `timeout` at the deadline, CancellationError on cancel, else the operation's result/error.
units.entry: Called from RRCollector+OvernightArming.swift:45, PolarManager+Recording.swift:462, StrapRecordingCoordinator+Transfer.swift:116 and :322; test StrapTransferTests.swift:206.

units.does: Stores the ResumeOnce; if already cancelled resumes CancellationError; else starts a clock Task (expire) and a call Task (run), records both, and if cancel() ran meanwhile calls cancel() again so the new tasks get cancelled.

branches.effect: true: resumes with CancellationError and returns without starting tasks; false: starts clock and call tasks

branches.cond: cancelled flag set while tasks were being created
branches.effect: true: cancel() resumes (no-op if already resumed) and cancels both tasks; false: nothing

units.does: Marks the race cancelled, resumes the caller with CancellationError (ignored if already resumed), and cancels the clock and call tasks.
units.entry: withTaskCancellationHandler onCancel in StrapDeadline.race (caller's task cancelled, e.g. user Cancel on a strap transfer).

units.does: Sleeps `seconds`; if the sleep is cancelled (call finished first) returns silently; otherwise resumes the caller with `timeout` and cancels both tasks.

branches.effect: catch: return silently — expected when the operation finished first; no throw: deadline reached, caller resumed with timeout

units.does: Awaits the operation, resumes the caller with its value or error, then cancels the clock task.
calls: closure:operation passed by StrapDeadline.race callers (SDK calls)

branches.effect: catch: caller resumed with that error (dropped if deadline/cancel already resumed); no throw: resumed with value

units.does: Under a lock flips `resumed` and resumes the continuation only the first time; later results are dropped.
units.entry: Invoked as a function by StrapRace.begin/cancel/expire/run.

branches.effect: true: continuation resumed with the result; false: result dropped
